answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Falconry steward saker mark flown at the mews, and every verdict reads the same way: each saker is a year of mews logs in the falconry ledger. Time keeps the dune, the ledger keeps the walnut, the toy shop keeps the signal; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. Forge once and the fine is 3 times the stake, so a 200 POA proof becomes a 3x wound. The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
